title: Maximum speed value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the maximum speed as 20 m/s (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Average velocity method
description: Important Criteria: The solution should apply the relation for uniform acceleration that total displacement equals average velocity multiplied by total time.

title: AB segment kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use a kinematic equation (e.g., v² = 2a₁x₁) to find the acceleration on slope AB.

title: AB force balance
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law on slope AB to relate acceleration, gravity, and friction.

title: Friction coefficient value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the kinetic friction coefficient on AB as 0.5 (or equivalent).

title: BC segment kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use a kinematic equation on slope BC to find the deceleration magnitude.

title: BC force balance
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Newton's second law on slope BC to find the total resistance force.

title: Resistance force value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the average resistance force on BC as 480 N (or equivalent with correct units).

title: Sign error in forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the direction of friction or net force is reversed on either incline (e.g., wrong sign in Newton's law).

title: Unit omission or misuse
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if final answers lack proper units or use incorrect units (e.g., cm/s for speed).
